methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Bitly in the browser. Choose only the intended workspace. Review the discovered actions and keep writes and destructive operations disabled until explicitly needed.
methods.label: Sign in with Bitly
warnings: The mcp.all scope covers Bitly's broad MCP catalog, including link and QR management, analytics, groups, custom domains, and Bitly Sites.

The catalog includes publishing and deletion operations, including permanent short-link deletion, site deletion, and custom-domain changes. Review the full catalog and keep write and destructive actions Off during read-only qualification.

methods.whenToUse: Use a customer-created Bitly API token when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Generate a Bitly API token under Settings → API. The token may authorize the MCP's full catalog under your Bitly account; Paperclip cannot narrow the token. Review discovered actions and keep writes and destructive operations disabled until explicitly needed.
methods.label: Use an API key

credentialFields.label: Bitly API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Bitly's API token may authorize the MCP's broad catalog under your account. Paperclip cannot narrow the token; keep write and destructive actions Off unless you explicitly need them.

warnings: This API token is not documented as a restricted MCP token. It may authorize Bitly's broad MCP catalog, including link creation/update/deletion, QR codes, Sites publishing/deletion, and custom-domain operations.
Review the discovered catalog and keep write and destructive actions Off during read-only qualification.
